targets.CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.2)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0168 NEW)
project(
    Gateway.Api
    VERSION 0.1.0
    LANGUAGES CXX)

include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(
    ncbuild
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/NavalCommand/Build.CMake.git
    GIT_TAG main)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(ncbuild)
include("${ncbuild_SOURCE_DIR}/NavalCommand.Build.CMake.cmake")

NavalCommandConfigureModule()
targets.managed\\CMakeLists.txt:
NavalCommandManagedProtoc(protocPath)
NavalCommandManagedContext("Protoc=${protocPath}")
NavalCommandAddManagedProject(Gateway.Api.Managed Gateway.Api.csproj)
if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL AND BUILD_TESTING)
    NavalCommandAddManagedProject(api-conformance "../test/managed/Conformance.csproj")
endif()
targets.src\\CMakeLists.txt:
find_package(Protobuf CONFIG REQUIRED)
set(GATEWAY_API_PROTO_DIR
    "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/proto"
    CACHE INTERNAL "Canonical payload source" FORCE)
set(generatedDirectory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${generatedDirectory}")
foreach(protoName session orders world incidents)
    set(protoRelativePath "navalcommand/gateway/v1/${protoName}")
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${generatedDirectory}/${protoRelativePath}.pb.cc"
               "${generatedDirectory}/${protoRelativePath}.pb.h"
        COMMAND protobuf::protoc --proto_path=${GATEWAY_API_PROTO_DIR}
                --cpp_out=${generatedDirectory} ${GATEWAY_API_PROTO_DIR}/${protoRelativePath}.proto
        DEPENDS "${GATEWAY_API_PROTO_DIR}/${protoRelativePath}.proto" protobuf::protoc)
    list(APPEND generatedSources "${generatedDirectory}/${protoRelativePath}.pb.cc")
endforeach()
add_library(Gateway.Api STATIC ${generatedSources} NavalCommand/Gateway/Api/Codec.cpp)
target_include_directories(Gateway.Api PUBLIC "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/public"
                                              "${generatedDirectory}")
target_link_libraries(Gateway.Api PUBLIC protobuf::libprotobuf)
NavalCommandConfigureTarget(Gateway.Api)
targets.test\\CMakeLists.txt:
find_package(GTest CONFIG REQUIRED)
add_executable(api-tests NavalCommand/Gateway/Api/CodecTest.cpp)
target_link_libraries(api-tests PRIVATE Gateway.Api GTest::gtest_main)
NavalCommandConfigureTarget(api-tests)
add_test(NAME codec COMMAND api-tests)
find_program(DOTNET_EXECUTABLE dotnet REQUIRED)
add_test(NAME managed-conformance
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" "-DDOTNET=${DOTNET_EXECUTABLE}"
        "-DPROJECT=${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/test/managed/Conformance.csproj"
        "-DCONFIGURATION=$<CONFIG>" "-DROUNDTRIP=$<TARGET_FILE:schema-roundtrip>"
        "-DOUTPUT_DIRECTORY=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/conformance/$<CONFIG>"
        -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ManagedConformance.cmake")

targets.CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.2)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0168 NEW)
project(
    Gateway.Grpc.Api
    VERSION 0.1.0
    LANGUAGES CXX)

include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(
    ncbuild
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/NavalCommand/Build.CMake.git
    GIT_TAG main)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(ncbuild)
include("${ncbuild_SOURCE_DIR}/NavalCommand.Build.CMake.cmake")

NavalCommandAddDependency(https://github.com/NavalCommand/Gateway.Api.git main)

NavalCommandConfigureModule()
targets.app\\CMakeLists.txt:
add_executable(naval-cli NavalCommand/Gateway/Grpc/Api/Cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(naval-cli PRIVATE Gateway.Grpc.Api protobuf::libprotobuf)
NavalCommandConfigureTarget(naval-cli)
targets.src\\CMakeLists.txt:
find_package(Protobuf CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(gRPC CONFIG REQUIRED)
set(generatedDirectory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${generatedDirectory}")
set(protoRelativePath "navalcommand/gateway/v1/service")
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${generatedDirectory}/${protoRelativePath}.pb.cc"
           "${generatedDirectory}/${protoRelativePath}.pb.h"
           "${generatedDirectory}/${protoRelativePath}.grpc.pb.cc"
           "${generatedDirectory}/${protoRelativePath}.grpc.pb.h"
    COMMAND
        protobuf::protoc --proto_path=${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/proto
        --proto_path=${GATEWAY_API_PROTO_DIR} --cpp_out=${generatedDirectory}
        --grpc_out=${generatedDirectory}
        --plugin=protoc-gen-grpc=$<TARGET_FILE:gRPC::grpc_cpp_plugin>
        "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/proto/${protoRelativePath}.proto"
    DEPENDS "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/proto/${protoRelativePath}.proto" protobuf::protoc
            gRPC::grpc_cpp_plugin)
add_library(Gateway.Grpc.Api STATIC "${generatedDirectory}/${protoRelativePath}.pb.cc"
                                    "${generatedDirectory}/${protoRelativePath}.grpc.pb.cc")
target_include_directories(Gateway.Grpc.Api PUBLIC "${generatedDirectory}")
target_link_libraries(Gateway.Grpc.Api PUBLIC Gateway.Api gRPC::grpc++)
NavalCommandConfigureTarget(Gateway.Grpc.Api)

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.2)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0168 NEW)
project(
    SeaPower.Mod
    VERSION 0.1.0
    LANGUAGES CXX)

include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(
    ncbuild
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/NavalCommand/Build.CMake.git
    GIT_TAG main)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(ncbuild)
include("${ncbuild_SOURCE_DIR}/NavalCommand.Build.CMake.cmake")

NavalCommandAddDependency(https://github.com/NavalCommand/Gateway.Api.git main)
NavalCommandAddDependency(https://github.com/NavalCommand/Gateway.Grpc.Api.git main)
NavalCommandAddDependency(https://github.com/NavalCommand/Gateway.Grpc.git main)
NavalCommandAddDependency(https://github.com/NavalCommand/SeaPower.Client.git main)

NavalCommandConfigureModule()
targets.managed\\CMakeLists.txt:
NavalCommandGetDependencySource(https://github.com/NavalCommand/Gateway.Api.git apiSource)
NavalCommandGetDependencySource(https://github.com/NavalCommand/SeaPower.Client.git clientSource)
NavalCommandManagedProtoc(protocPath)
set(gameManaged "")
if (SEAPOWER_GAME_ROOT)
    set(gameManaged "${SEAPOWER_GAME_ROOT}/Sea Power_Data/Managed")
endif ()
NavalCommandManagedContext("GatewayApiSource=${apiSource}" "SeaPowerClientSource=${clientSource}"
        "Protoc=${protocPath}" "GameManaged=${gameManaged}")
NavalCommandAddManagedProject(managed-runtime runtime/SeaPower.Mod.csproj)
add_dependencies(managed-runtime SeaPower.Host)
NavalCommandAddManagedProject(managed-harness harness/SeaPower.Harness.csproj)
if (PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL AND BUILD_TESTING)
    NavalCommandAddManagedProject(managed-tests "../test/managed/RuntimeTests.csproj")
endif ()

find_program(POWERSHELL_EXECUTABLE pwsh REQUIRED)
add_custom_target(package-runtime
        COMMAND "${POWERSHELL_EXECUTABLE}" -NoProfile -File "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/Package.ps1"
        -Kind Runtime -Configuration "$<CONFIG>" -NativeHost "$<TARGET_FILE:SeaPower.Host>"
        -ApiSource "${apiSource}" -VcpkgInstalled "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" -Triplet "${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}"
        DEPENDS SeaPower.Host managed-runtime
        VERBATIM)
add_custom_target(package-harness
        COMMAND "${POWERSHELL_EXECUTABLE}" -NoProfile -File "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/Package.ps1"
        -Kind Harness -Configuration "$<CONFIG>"
        DEPENDS managed-harness
        VERBATIM)
